unlisted_practices: Using an LLM-based conversational interface to administer depression screening (BDI-FS) and comparing its scores and diagnoses with PHQ-9 and psychiatrist CIS-R diagnosis
Assessing participants' subjective acceptance and comfort with an LLM-based assessment versus a standard questionnaire

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates an interactive LLM-based tool (custom ChatGPT) for depression screening with real human participants, assessing diagnostic performance and subjective experience, but does not compare or test specific deployment practices or safeguards.
